description: Northern Province - The Northern Province Road Passengers Transport Authority Statute No. 01 of 2016
categorisation: This gazette content establishes a new legal framework - the Northern Province Road Passengers Transport Authority Statute, No. 01 of 2016. It contains the full text of the statute including its objects, establishment of the authority, constitution of the board, operational procedures, and legal provisions. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it involves new regulations, statutory instruments, and legal frameworks for regulating road passenger transport services in the Northern Province.
